answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 62290 Country: India Title: Unlawful sexual relationship performed by my sister Question: My sister is married for 12 years and has a kid. She was caught having illegal relationship and had performed unlawful sexual relationship (zina) with one of her relative who is also married. Though, my brother-in-law went ahead and forgave his wife for the illegal act performed by my sister with the hope that Allah will forgive her and wants to lead a normal life with my sister again. Is it okay as per Islam for my brother-in-law to continue relationship? Please guide us per the teachings of the Holy Prophet (SAW) and Quran, Hadith. Answer ID: 62290 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 130/114/N=02/1437) The relatives with whom your sister established illegal relationship if he is not among your sister’s father-in-law, father-in-law’s father, her husband’s grandfather, son of the husband etc as it is also obvious from the question then she did not become haram on her husband (your bahnoi). Hence it is lawful for your bahnoi to keep her as his wife and continue marital life with her as before. قال في رد المحتار (كتاب النكاح، فصل فى المحرمات 4:109 ط مكتبه زكريا ديوبند) عن البحر؛ لا اعتبار لماء الزاني ولذا لو زنت امرأة رجل لم تحرم عليه وجاز له وطؤها عقب الزنا اهـ . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
